# JMIR mHealth and uHealth

> A peer-reviewed, open-access journal publishing cutting-edge research on mobile health technologies, digital health interventions, and ubiquitous health solutions.

JMIR mHealth and uHealth is an indexed, high-impact journal (MEDLINE, PubMed, Scopus, JCR) that covers mobile health applications, wearable devices, telemedicine, and behavioral health interventions. The journal is led by Editor-in-Chief Lorraine R. Buis and publishes rigorous research on mHealth effectiveness, implementation, and real-world outcomes.

## Key Topics

- mHealth
- mobile health
- digital health
- wearable devices
- telemedicine
- behavior change
- cardiac rehabilitation
- randomized controlled trials
- open-access publishing
- peer review
- impact factor
- MEDLINE indexing
- mHealth interventions
- patient engagement
- ubiquitous health

## Research Collections

- [Top Articles](https://mhealth.jmir.org/top-articles/overview): Most-viewed articles on mHealth research and wearable devices
- [Journal Issues](https://mhealth.jmir.org/issues): Journal issues archive and publication volumes
- [Thematic Collections](https://mhealth.jmir.org/themes): Thematic collections on mHealth topics including EMA and telemedicine
- [mHealth for Rehabilitation](https://mhealth.jmir.org/themes/510): Thematic collection on mHealth rehabilitation for Parkinson disease
- [mHealth for Wellness, Behavior Change and Prevention](https://mhealth.jmir.org/themes/188): Thematic collection on mHealth interventions for wellness and prevention

## Featured Research

- [Smartphone Cardiac Rehabilitation, Assisted Self-Management (SCRAM) Versus Usual Care](https://mhealth.jmir.org/2026/1/e66074): Research article on SCRAM telerehabilitation for cardiac patients
- [Adherence to mHealth Physical Activity Intervention After Mild Stroke or Transient Ischemic Attack](https://mhealth.jmir.org/2026/1/e75662): Research article on mHealth adherence for post-stroke physical activity
